observations.detail: Opening shot starts with the dialogue hook 'Watch this hammer!' matching the speech balloon.
High Valhalla weapon shatters the mountain peak with clear visual framing and punchy pacing.
Wong's machine gunners blast away; subtitle word-by-word display is clean and legible.
Grant speeding across the sky on a thunderbolt with vibrant color and smooth transition.
Storm unleashes with red danger emphasis matching production settings.
Avalanche descends with the sound effect CRASH! integrated naturally into the narration.
Ending shot cleanly concludes the sequence as Grant and Glenda fly back to civilization.

summary: The candidate video successfully executes the script with high visual readability, accurate subtitle synchronization, and energetic narration matching all production settings.
